decision: Base image to advance to hosted CI for CRA2 owner-only Cloud Run preparation
decision_limits: A comparison of available exact image specimens for continuing CI. It does not choose a distribution in general or authorize image publication/deployment.

evidence.claim: Current complete image builds, verifies its runtime smoke, and is blocked on 104 High, Critical or Unknown scan matches; known-vulnerable control passed.

The bound local release scan attributes all 104 blocking matches to 20 Debian binary packages, covering 40 distinct advisory IDs. The scanner reports zero fixed-version entries for those matches. That is not a vendor-level applicability or available-patch determination.

A direct registry read on 2026-11-16 returned the same Linux amd64 debug and nonroot digests as the current builder and runtime pins for those tags. This compares the pinned and current Debian image inputs only, not the two remediation options.
Debian provides official package/advisory status and Distroless tracks Debian updates. Vendor reconciliation can be performed before building a candidate.
Wolfi publishes a package repository for production images. No app-specific Wolfi digest, signature, package resolution or scan was measured here.
All 40 advisory/source pairs in the baseline image are open for Debian 13 and there is no fixed version recorded in the release feed for any of them.

Same Syft/Grype versions and database timestamp, no suppressions: existing Debian 104 blocking matches across 162 inventoried packages; Wolfi zero across 159 packages and four matches total. Both detection controls passed. Same Python lock and encoder. Wolfi verified six offline intents, nonroot HTTP startup and four unsigned IAP route denials.

The pinned Wolfi OCI index is publisher-signature verified and binds the Linux amd64 manifest; Podman used it to build the test candidate. Syft and Grype identified and inventoried Wolfi APK packages, Python and npm.
